description: This file defines a class for secret detection and redaction in messages and prompts, used as a guardrail in LLM calls. It includes configuration for various secret detection plugins and methods for scanning message content for secrets, redacting them, and integrating with call hooks.

classes.name: _ENTERPRISE_SecretDetection
classes.description: A class extending CustomGuardrail for secret detection and redaction in messages and prompts, with configurable secret detection plugins and integrated call hooks.

methods.name: scan_message_for_secrets
methods.description: Scans a message content string for secrets using configured plugins, returning a list of detected secrets with their types and values.

methods.name: should_run_check
methods.description: Checks if the secret detection guardrail should run based on user API key permissions.

methods.name: async_pre_call_hook
methods.description: Pre-call hook that scans and redacts secrets in message content, prompt, and input fields of the data before proceeding with the call.
